body:
**Triage: `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#6136`.** `domain:spec-tooling` was already correct and is kept; the missing half was a pm-state label — without one this issue was **invisible to every queue view**, which is the same gap #6188 and #6186 hit in earlier rounds.

## Stale-premise check — `origin/main` `72847c5`

Both halves hold, verbatim:

- `packages/spec/scripts/lib/file-description.ts:185` still reads
  `/(?<!\()\b((?:\.\.\/)?[\w-]+\/[\w.-]+\.zod\.ts)\b(?!\))/g` — `\b` before the optional `(?:\.\.\/)?`, one level only.
- The two published pages still carry the naked prefix:
  `content/docs/references/api/http-cache.mdx:52` and `content/docs/references/system/cache.mdx:40`.

## One correction to the acceptance criterion — it cannot be measured until #6136 lands

The body proposes `grep -rn '\.\./\[' content/docs/references/` **going to zero** as the acceptance. On main that grep returns **5** hits, not 2, and only 2 of them belong to this issue:

| file:line | shape | owner |
|---|---|---|
| `api/http-cache.mdx:52` | `../../[system/cache.zod.ts](…)` | **this issue** |
| `system/cache.mdx:40` | `../../[api/http-cache.zod.ts](…)` | **this issue** |
| `automation/etl.mdx:54` | `[../[integration/connector.zod.ts](…)](…)` | #6136 (nested link) |
| `integration/connector.mdx:102` | `[../[automation/etl.zod.ts](…)](…)` | #6136 (nested link) |
| `data/feed.mdx:16` | `` `../[ui/component.zod.ts](…)` `` inside a code span | #6136 |

So the "zero hits" criterion is a **joint** criterion for #6136 + this issue, and running it before PR #6224 merges reports a failure this fix cannot cause. Whoever takes this should either wait for that merge (which the `Blocked-by:` enforces) or narrow the assertion to the two pages above.

## Why `pm:blocked` rather than `pm:queue`

PR #6224 (#5553 / #6136, **`pm:dispatched`**) is in flight and edits **the same rewriter chain in the same file** — the `{@link …}` passes at `:178`/`:180` immediately above, and it changes what reaches `:185`. Two devs on `file-description.ts` at once is the merge race step 3 serializes on. The body already records that #6224 deliberately did *not* pin this shape (pinning it would have ratified it) and points at this issue from its test comments, so the ordering is the filer's intent too. Unblocks when #6136 closes.

## Not on the release board

Presentation-only, two reference pages, no runtime or protocol semantics — improvement class, not a blocker under any of the four criteria. It is cheap and visible, so it will likely ride the next `spec-tooling` batch on its merits rather than on a board label.

## Dedup (three repos, open issues **and** PRs)

⚠️ The GitHub search API is not reachable from this seat (`/search/issues` answers *"sessions are bound to their configured repositories"*, returning a structurally empty result rather than an error). Dedup was done by paginating **all 442 open issues and PRs** across the three repos and matching locally on `file-description`, `docs-gen`, `../[`.

The docs-gen family is crowded, and all three neighbours are distinct inputs to the same renderer — no duplicate: **#6136** (untitled `{@link}` → nested link; the dependency above), **#5553** (JSDoc line layout, same PR #6224), **#5853** (`getCategoryTitle()` capitalisation). This issue is the only one whose input carries **no** `{@link}` at all — the link is produced entirely by the `:185` rewriter, which is why it survives #6224.
